purpose: Provide explicit, revocable, time-bounded execution authority downstream of evidence qualification, assurance and custodial preflights.
validation_rules: valid_from and valid_until use timezone-aware timestamps and current time must fall within the interval
requested domain and execution depth must be explicitly allowed
requested cascade class must not exceed max_cascade_class
requested task/project/object/configuration must fit declared scope when the corresponding scope list is non-empty
planned specialist floors must be a subset of allowed_floors
COMPUTE_ONLY may invoke bounded models/solvers and write operational receipts but cannot authorise provider writes, publication or actuation
consequential C2+ or DIGITAL_WRITE/EXTERNAL_ACTION/PHYSICAL_ACTUATION requires applicable assurance/custodial receipts and separately scoped authority/risk acceptance
DIGITAL_WRITE and above require rollback_or_recovery_ref where reversal is meaningful
EXTERNAL_ACTION and PHYSICAL_ACTUATION require stop_authority_ref and safe_state_ref
PHYSICAL_ACTUATION additionally requires independently verified safety/interlock state
resource/tool budgets are ceilings, never targets
PRE_LAUNCH or LAUNCH_TRANSITION consequential execution requires root_authority_receipt_ref
publish execution requires release_receipt_ref even when the model/runtime plan is otherwise cleared
authority_phase_ref must resolve to the current promoted governance/phase contract

when standing_internal_execution_authority conditions are all satisfied, the standing root-authority receipt is sufficient for PRE_LAUNCH internal execution and no additional per-action founder approval is required

compatibility.legacy_operator_approval_manifest: historical evidence of operator decisions only; may support issuance of a new lease but cannot itself satisfy this contract
compatibility.achilles_action_envelope: may reference an ACTIVE lease; action-envelope approval does not silently mint one

lease_classes.READ_ONLY: read/query/review; no mutation and no model/tool side effects beyond bounded source access
lease_classes.COMPUTE_ONLY: LLM/classical solver/simulation invocation with receipts; no external mutation, publication or physical actuation
lease_classes.DIGITAL_WRITE: bounded mutation of approved digital targets with readback/rollback
lease_classes.EXTERNAL_ACTION: network/provider action affecting an external system, person or release surface
lease_classes.PHYSICAL_ACTUATION: command capable of changing physical state

phase_rules.PRE_LAUNCH: Consequential execution requires a current root_authority_receipt_ref plus authority_phase_ref.
phase_rules.LAUNCH_TRANSITION: Consequential execution remains root-authority-gated until the exact distributed governance state is promoted.
phase_rules.DISTRIBUTED_OPERATION: Authority is determined by the promoted multidimensional authority matrix; pre-launch root receipt is not assumed to remain required.
phase_rules.SUCCESSION_OR_RECOVERY: Use the promoted succession/recovery constitution and preserve degraded-mode safety constraints.

publication_rule: Any publish execution requires release_receipt_ref. Public publication must also pass the CGP-IES release-visibility preflight.

standing_internal_execution_authority.principle: internal + reversible + evidence-bound + within ACTIVE lease may execute without per-action founder reapproval
all_required: target is internal to the authorised Cognigrex/CGX working environment
ACTIVE lease resolves and requested task/object/action fits declared scope
action does not expand semantic, root or governance authority
mutation is reversible where reversal is meaningful and rollback_or_recovery_ref is present
readback/verification and operational receipt are produced for digital mutation
applicable assurance/custodial/risk controls already required by the lease remain satisfied
per_action_founder_reapproval_not_requir: bounded internal DIGITAL_WRITE with rollback/readback inside lease
canonical data assembly that leaves unknowns explicit
tests, simulation, derivation, reconciliation, indexing and receipt generation
explicit_gate_required_for: contractual, legal, financial or material IP-ownership commitment
irreversible deletion of irreplaceable evidence/recovery lineage
EXTERNAL_ACTION unless separately and explicitly authorised
PHYSICAL_ACTUATION and any physical safety-boundary change
authority expansion beyond the promoted envelope
standing_internal_execution_authority.audit_boundary: Achilles may audit, stop, quarantine or require re-proof; this standing authority does not turn Achilles into a competing operational executor.
